_comment: Copy this to %USERPROFILE%\.zamolxis\rvsq-config.json and fill in ONE ENTRY PER PERSON you want watched (yourself, a spouse, kids…). This file stays on your machine only — never committed, logged, or sent anywhere but the official RVSQ site. NAM = the health-insurance number on the RAMQ card; card_seq_number = the small sequence number after the name on the card; birth_month = the value the RVSQ month dropdown expects (try the two-digit month, e.g. 03). Optional per-person overrides: headless, radius_km, consulting_reason. Set "disabled": true on an entry to skip it. headless/radius_km at the top level are defaults for everyone.
